_readme: Guest reviews shown on the homepage, quoted word for word (an ellipsis marks a shortened quote). Guest names, details and photos are used with each reviewer's written permission (keep the permissions on file). Run tools/build_properties.py after editing.

reviews.name: Daniel Akkerman
reviews.title: CEO of Veltiq AI
reviews.text: The executive rental condo was right in the heart of the city: immaculate, thoughtfully furnished, and set up for focused work. Communication was prompt and professional from booking to check-out, and the whole process was streamlined. It is exactly the standard I look for when I travel for business.

reviews.name: Andrew
reviews.text: A great place for a long business trip for myself and one of my coworkers. Very safe and secure. The instructions were spot on. Will likely be back.

reviews.name: Melina
reviews.text: The place was beautifully decorated, immaculate, and spotless—it truly felt like a boutique hotel. Every detail was thoughtfully considered, from the recent updates and stylish decor to the complimentary breakfast cereals, coffee, tea, and bottled water that made mornings easy and relaxing. …

reviews.name: Steve
reviews.text: Very clean and comfortable place. Thoughtful amenities throughout especially kitchen and bathrooms. Private backyard with covered patio and fire pit great space for eating a meal or just hanging out. Would stay here again.

reviews.name: Matthew
reviews.text: This is a beautiful 19th floor apartment in a fantastic location. Beautifully appointed. Great shower, lovely beds, nice living room, kitchen that has everything. Lovely building, secure and safe. We loved staying here.

reviews.name: Mary
reviews.text: My husband and I really enjoyed our stay here. This is such a great location. You are a 10 minute walk to Coors Field (Colorado Rockies) and 10 minute walk to Ball Arena (Denver Nuggets and Colorado Avalanche). …

reviews.name: Tawni
reviews.text: Highly recommend this spot for a stay in the Denver area. It’s a quick, easy Uber ride to several hotspots, yet the neighborhood itself is just as enjoyable—perfect for relaxing and unwinding close to home or working remotely. Book now.

reviews.name: Jeannie
reviews.text: I am so happy I chose this home! We were travelling with my 90 year old mother and were looking for ease and comfort. We found it here! Thank you for all the thoughtful touches!
